content: Jesus barasam
Sabbath tom menaram se aniram ukiram, tumong biyala day tom 1 mu te, Maria Magdalene se Maria bo tala mu ali motam arigimonko namaman.
Se wanara biya kaparam se Kari Biya ko engel bo duruk wonong te wore tai kaparam, ale manga biya ali motam kuring te baguman mu gurugu karogo nama due ko beteram, ale awote daigam.
Noko kumik nikim mu pure nikim iwita, se ko guang mu siraram nunguningkiri.
Se kari ali motam bitaruwaman mu ninguru nguangaman, ale nungumik barowara makaso, se dagulaman ale kua titimaman.
Se engel nu imet mu nunga maonam, “Nina me nguangaralko,” mam. “Ani ikisam, nina Jesus tam kangono te tagiman wore ko loagawasan,” mam.
“Bare nu ewela me bagoso. Nu kota balam butata nu maingkala barasam. Iweya, ewela tairal ale kuwim te aniwaram mu arigalko.
Asele pasak ala namaral ale ko olekem alo nunga maonalko, nu maingkala barasam ale aitak mu giram Galilee namaram, se nuna Galilee namamon ale arigimonko. Ani den aitak ninga manem butata beteralko.”
Se imet ilagala mu ali motam beteman, ale nguanga se wore aking amilmil te biririka nama se nagu nagu namamon ale ko olekem alo nunga manarmonko namakasan.
Se Jesus nongoma te aratam, ale “Amilmil yawara,” mam. Se nuna kote namaman ale suwik duap ningi dagulaman, ale suwik iluman ale nup patawukasan.
Se Jesus nunga maonam, “Me nguangaralko. Namaral ale aninga launuria alo nunga maonal se Galilee namamon ale mu te asele ani agarkamonko.”
Priest se supuling bibiya nunga kawel
Se tom imet mu namawaman mu kari ali motam bitaruwaman mu nunga sang peleman wonong biya ningi kasu naguman, ale mel singir la aratam mu ko duap priest bibiya alo nunga manorman.
Se priest bibiya mu kari bibiya arungu biguwuman ale ikia bo kaloman. Ale manga biyala kari ali motam bitaruwaman mu nungarman,
ale nunga manorman, “Nina iwita balalko, ‘Noko olekem alo tirom ana aniwaman se taiman ale ko kumik guang tere taman,’ malko.
Se den imi governor biya, Pilate, dogowa nagurok se ikiok, mu ana ilak munakanak se nina ikup bo ningimik te me aratukko.”
Se bitua kari alo manga mu taman ale namaman priest alo balman butata balu gilingiman. Se tom umutang te se tai aitak mu Juda alo den imi am balu se iki lagasan.
Olekem alo ura ko sokel taman
Se tom olekem 11 mu Galilee namaman mu, duruk gotek bo Jesus te namamonko nunga maonam mu te namaman.
Ale tom nu arigiman mu ko nup patawukasan; bare sang nungamin yenakaso.
Se Jesus nongote pingi tairam ale mam, “Nup biya se sokel biya duruk wonong te se ali imi te ta, mu Kaem ani aisu saparam.
Buta se, nina sor suen biya te namaral ale aninga olekem ko nunga gial, ale Nuet ko nup te, Namar nup te, se Bur Laili nup te anuwa marak nungaralko,
ale munan suen la ani ninga manem mu nunga kausal se ikimon ale karo tumonko. Ale ikialko, ani me ta ninga bitirik, nengerak la bagarik nama tom nukum arukko,” mam.

footnotes.text: Kari Biya Jesus pempem ko kariimet arungu bagarukko: Deuteronomy 31:6.
